cells.evidence_grade: proved (model) for the engine premises' link; inspected for the verdicts outside the contract
cells.product_basis: supplement: every proof-premise condition of reflection/closure.json (72) and 7 PROOFS.md premises it does not list now have a checked verdict against the contract's Verus specification instead of an inspection link: closure rows proved 9, proved-in-part 10, proved under the product's discipline 5, shown false 3 (Txn.cls:8, P-C5, P-U2), outside the contract 9, progress 36; plus P-C04 permitted-not-implied (an abort is always permitted). Each proved premise names the clause it needs: 17 located controls, each with a verified counterexample. The head-lock premises (P-C01, P-D9-1, P-L3, P-S1) are proved under the discipline 'disc' (writes to the ledger globals only by the exclusive head-lock holder inside its transaction): an inductive invariant over every operation of every process plus the holder's all-or-none / stop-leaves-nothing theorem. Corrections the proofs make to the premises as worded: P-D9-2 for an INSERT of a key an open bypass inserted is an immediate -119, not a wait; P-D9-2 over an erasure's uncommitted delete and P-C04 are not implied (both outcomes permitted); P-A6 restores before-images only of nodes nobody wrote since (E-ROLLBACK-OTHER). P-0001 and the nested-commit cases of P-C01 / P-D9-1 now rest on an observation of E-STOP's every-level reading (env-estop-gap; mutant stop-rolls-back-top-level-only killed, proofs-env-mutants-r2)
cells.remaining: the discipline 'disc' against the product's code (D-3/D-4; violated by EraseGraph at the pin, F-1201); progress premises (36 rows) not implied by any clause; outside-contract premises (CreateGUID, sha256, caller identity, durability, statement granularity, %ID, multi-row DELETE scan, embedded SQL) stay assumed or executable-only; several locks / regions are linked premise by premise, not composed into one invariant

proof_debt_proposals.proposed_text: The IRIS environment contract as a Verus specification linked to the participant contracts: **paid at model level for the contract's Verus subset** by `proofs-env` (305 verified, 0 errors, `--no-cheating`, empty trust inventory, `proofs-env-baseline`; recheck `proofs-env-recheck-*`): the clauses the proof crates rely on (nesting and partial rollback, SQL / driver verbs ending one or every level, stop rolls back every level, deferred unlock, lock names / modes / counts / waits, row locks with waits and -119, READ UNCOMMITTED for globals and SQL, value-based rollback, $INCREMENT) as a step function with the contract's permitted-outcome structure (the Freedom); an exec model verified against it agrees with iris-contract r6 / contract-2 on every recorded in-subset case, incl. the targeted rounds env-estop-gap and env-dml-single, 0 observations outside (`proofs-env-differential-r3`); all 29 Verus-model mutants killed by observations (`proofs-env-mutants-r3`); every proof-premise condition of CLOSURE.md mapped to a theorem or a verdict (`proofs-env-premise-map`), 17 located controls each with a verified counterexample. Head-lock premises (P-C01, P-D9-1, P-L3, P-S1) proved under the product discipline `disc` (an inductive invariant over every operation of every process plus the all-or-none / stop-leaves-nothing holder theorem)
proof_debt_proposals.still_open: the discipline `disc` against the code (D-3/D-4); the extension clauses (incl. INSERT ... SELECT), E-1 and X2 outside the Verus subset; progress premises; several locks / regions not composed into one invariant; the Freedom's proceeding branch unobserved
